note: Every first-party skill appears here: as source under skills/, or as an entry that says where it lives and why it is not copied. Third-party skills are not listed.

statuses.system-coupled: depends on a larger system and stays with it
statuses.adapted: derived from someone else's skill; credited, not republished
statuses.retired: no longer in use; history only

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Compiles messy source material into a self-contained Markdown evidence packet that keeps material detail and each statement's epistemic status, and reads the repository's status quo first when run inside one.
skills.reason: Written for this repository. Standalone.

skills.name: prompt-compile
skills.description: Define, do, verify: compile a task brief, execute it, verify against it.
skills.reason: Already published in its own public repository with its gate hook. A second copy would fork it.

skills.description: Audits a repo's dependencies, recommends the smallest right stack, and applies changes after approval.
skills.reason: Already published in its own public repository with an installer.

skills.reason: Already published as the claritymaxx plugin.

skills.name: shipwright

skills.reason: Already published in its own public plugin repository.

skills.name: qc-questions
skills.description: Quality-checks multiple-choice assessment questions with blind-solve subagents and difficulty estimation.
skills.reason: Already published in its own public plugin repository.

skills.description: Generates a single-file HTML visualizer from a brand-guide.md.

skills.name: prd-journeys
skills.description: Generates user journeys, Mermaid flows and a screen inventory from a PRD.

skills.name: task-contract
skills.description: Reads an underspecified request as five fields (Task, Done, Constraints, Verify, Stop) before work starts.
skills.invocation: loaded by the model when a request has no clear finish line
skills.reason: Portable, but paired with an always-on rule and install tests in dotfiles. Moving its canonical source is a separate change.

skills.name: browser-capture-fallbacks
skills.description: Fallback chain and known quirks for viewport-exact screenshots and logged-out page capture.
skills.invocation: loaded by the model when browser capture misbehaves
skills.reason: Portable. Held back pending a content and licence review: the file declares CC BY 4.0, which differs from this repository's MIT.

skills.name: product-gameplan
skills.description: Asks clarifying questions, then generates a phased idea-to-shipped gameplan with a tracker.

skills.name: jev-atlas
skills.description: Maps where semantic-judgment models belong in a codebase, tests the strongest candidates, then implements them.
skills.reason: Has its own dedicated repository with an installer. That repository is private.

skills.name: my-voice

skills.name: build-flow

skills.name: ai-build-flow-doctor

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Reads one finished session and prints RETRO blocks: what happened, the evidence, the root cause. Writes nothing.
skills.reason: Adapted from the retro skill in mattpocock/skills (MIT) and rewritten around the Build Flow doctor. Not standalone, and not original enough to publish as first-party.
